notes.title: Update 1.1 - Savepoints & Performance
notes.notes:
[b]Hello together![/b]

In this update we fixed the savepoints in the sewers and added even more in the first part of it. Also we've improved performance in the sewers and subway.

We will continue to work on our new project, of which we will release the store page soon in December, so stay tuned!

Thank you for your support,
Andreas & Dan

notes.title: Update V1.0.1 – More languages & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello together!

As announced, we have added the languages Russian, Turkish and Spanish and fixed some of the bugs you reported, such as the disappearance of the power box in the power house. 

In the next update, which will come in the next few days, we will fix the save points in the sewers and add more in the first part.

We will of course continue to listen to your feedback and possibly add more languages in the future, but for now we are working on the next project, about which we will have more information very soon!

Thank you and we hope you enjoy playing Psych!

notes.title: Psych Full Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We have great news to share with you. The development of the last chapter is going very well, so we have set a strict target to release version 1.0 including Chapter 5 on October 21, 2022. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/9933e90284d0c488599271b39152f02d04283f62.png[/img]

[h2]Chapter 5[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[i]*Warning, this section might contain some spoilers*[/i]

In this chapter, Alex uncovers the truth and faces unpleasant surprises that you, as the player, will have to experience. Some things will happen that you certainly won't expect. We're really excited to share the final chapter of Psych with you! Here's a sneak peek of the upcoming update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/884dc8aaaaa8f1f37696631c646eece9fc9aabd1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/ba874e03a98b30ae27829d6d335432b4bd06b19f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/9c0b910a3c21b8854b6814f7f9637ee005ecc4b6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/84ae4e394729f56432a2c23cc56cb88d9b83322b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/457875b2abc9cf82f21e54b70425ef688ebfbb29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We were able to make some improvements during development and fix all known bugs. The improvements gave us significantly more performance. In the park, we have an average of 30% more FPS, which will be especially noticeable on weaker systems. In addition, we have further enhanced some locations. We improved the quality of some textures with the help of AI to create a graphically even better experience. Last but not least, we will also be able to offer controller support with the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/394ba8ed63c2b3f791a21851b9dd94f7153416ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/acb31f3763a62813b6ead37915a8f33b678d46a5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Translations[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We also currently translating Psych into the following languages:
[list]
[*]German
[*]Chinese
[*]Turkish 
[*]Spanish
[*]Czech
[*]Russian
[/list]
[h2]After Version 1.0[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Of course, we will continue to respond to feedback, suggestions and bugs after the release of the final chapter. We pay attention to every opinion, because after all the community is working together with us on Psych. Psych will finally leave the Early Access status after the upcoming update and will be considered a full title. We will not be raising the price, as we feel that we have hit a good price point with Psych.

[h2]Future projects[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As in previously written announcements, something big will come after Psych. We can't give more details yet, but we are incredibly motivated and bursting with ideas. It won't be long after the release of the fifth chapter before you hear from us again, that much we can reveal!

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
Finally, we would like to thank you for the incredible time. To every support, to every opinion, to every feedback and of course to all the people from the community who played Psych. It's still our first big title and we can be really proud that we've brought together such a wonderful community. Thank you so very, very much!

Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Update V0.8.0 – Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
Thank you for your feedback to chapter 4 so far! Based on that we have made some improvements and fixed bugs:


[h3]New:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
- Redesigned loading screen between scenes
- Added more people searching in the park


[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
- Fixed the time display on all devices
- Fixed the footstep sounds & animation in the apartment
- Fixed the scare in the window (sometimes it didn't appear)
- Adjusted some voicelines
- Fixed hover icon bug on phone booth
- Fixed ui page didn't disappear when Alex get caught
- Adjusted train collision to prevent Alex getting stuck

notes.title: Update V0.4.0 – Chapter Selection
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

before we fully focus on chapter 4, we decided to publish a small update with ideas from the community. It was suggested that you can select the individual chapters in the main menu to play them again without having to start from the beginning:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/3567b9d107e2ab18e47609b2c77a11120166386c.png[/img]

Once you have unlocked a chapter, you can select it from the menu at any time. Please note, however, that if you press "New Game", all progress will be lost. This also applies to the unlocked chapters. So if you want to start from the beginning without losing your progress, please select "Chapter 1" in the selection.

Furthermore, we have made a few small changes in chapter 3, which are not mentioned here for spoiler reasons. The performance has also been improved in some areas and should be noticeable for players with weaker systems.

Feel free to send us more suggestions and ideas so that we can implement them in future updates! We can't say it often enough, but: Your feedback is incredibly important!

Until then, have fun with Psych, and we'll get back to work on Chapter 4!

See you soon,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Update V0.3.5 – New Content & Story
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello together![/h2]

We've taken a close look at your feedback on the latest content update that Chapter 3 brought. From improvements to navigation through the sewers to even more story content and more horror, it's all there. Now we're ready to share all the improvements you've asked for. We would like to take this opportunity to remind you that your feedback always comes first. We are very grateful for the community we have built up to this point! So here are the new improvements for update 0.3.5:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/25c42ea0a50e1cdce6fec0bd4e7bc7f9c7166da5.png[/img]

[h3]Back in the Park[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quest descriptions are now clearer and more helpful 
[*] The problem with the camera going crazy during chess has been fixed
[/list]

[h3]Alex's flat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the UI text not to disappear when reading the mail
[*] Alex's computer is now facing the right way
[*] The time on the mobile phone is now correct
[/list]

[h3]In the sewers[/h3]
[list]
[*] The flashlight is now brighter and lights farther
[*] Timed puzzles now have an hearable timer
[*] The generator room has been reworked
[*] New events and scenarios have been added
[*] New horror elements have been added
[*] A map to pick up has been added
[*] Cutscenes have been added
[*] Many new sound effects have been added
[*] New side story content has been added
[*] Some sound effects have been adjusted in volume
[*] The sewer has been reworked from the map design for easier navigation. Coloured markers now show the way
[*] The escalation system has been reworked and has more sound effects
[*] A pop-up tutorial now appears for the escalation system
[*] There is now an acoustic signal when all valves are put together
[*] Voice lines have been added to help the player in some sections
[*] Fixed a bug where the icon for opening doors did not disappear
[/list]

Once again, we ask for your feedback to bring more improvements in the future!

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We will continue with the work on the fourth chapter. We have some new features planned with the next chapter, which will again bring more mechanics and more variety. Expect the update in about 1-2 months. Behind the scenes, we are also experimenting a lot with network technology, for a yet unreleased project. 

Thank you very much for your attention and have fun playing! See you soon!

Dan and Andreas from MediaTale

notes.title: Update 0.2.5 – Happy Halloween
notes.notes:
[b]Hello together![/b]

While we continue to work on the next big update for the third chapter, which will be released in November, we have a small Halloween update with some improvements for you. We've listened to your feedback and made adjustments to improve Psych's gameplay experience.

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] The park of Psych has been enhanced with further details
[*] For controlling the brightness from the mobile phone, there is now a tutorial
[*] There is now a setting for controlling/disabling the head bob
[*]*SPOILER* The chase has been adjusted so that you have more time to find the key
[*] The rough position of the key is now shown as a hint in the task description (Hold tab)
[*] Some voice lines have been re-recorded to provide better immersion
[*] The bonus in the main menu was explained
[*] There are now new numbers to call in the phone booth
[*] Some texts were replaced and improved
[*] A new side quest was added
[*] The menu has been updated with the latest news and update information
[*] Searching for memories has been simplified and 9 instead of 5 memories are now spawned
[*] A new achievement was added
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Voice lines now stop when you die
[/list]

notes.title: Update V0.2.0 – New content & bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello together![/h2]

We hope you had a good time at the Whine Vale Park while we were working on an update! This update brings some improvements as well as new things to discover. We were also able to fix some bugs thanks to your feedback. For all of you who can't wait for Chapter 3, here's what you need to know: Chapter 3 will be the biggest chapter yet with new locations to discover. We'll be putting significantly more horror into this chapter than the other two, so get ready for something!

[h3]New:[/h3]
- You will now find an incomplete map at the entrance to the park. You will find the individual map pieces scattered around the park, which you can then collect and bring to the map to complete it.
- New achievement to complete the map
- There are new secrets to discover in the park. Look out for the burning candles. They may lead you to a story if you do everything right.
- New achievement to find out the secret
- Once you reach the point where you need to find the key, "something or someone" will help you by pointing you in the right direction.
- Hard to read texts can now be read in clear letters for help
- Some horror elements have been improved
- Some parts of the park have been made more detailed to provide more immersion
- Someone had reported that you can now hear a chant near the pond when you do something specific

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
- The main menu now shows the correct version number
- The radius for hanging up the phone in the phone booth is now larger
- Fixed a bug where you could accidentally walk into a "shadow"
- Fixed a bug where conversations were interrupted by other voice lines.

[h3]Performance:[/h3]
-Audio files have been compressed to improve performance so that large amounts of data are no longer loaded on demand

notes.title: Update V0.1.1 – Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
What an amazing start, you have overwhelmed us! We love hearing your feedback and watching your gameplay or streams! We found a few bugs that we fixed with this little update:

New:
- New option to invert mouse control
- The maximum brightness of the mobile phone light is now higher (controlled with the mouse wheel)

Fixed:
- Closing the eyes during a call results in having to open them again manually (instead of automatically)
- Clues to the puzzle with the electricity box improved
- Clearer instructions on what to do (Current Task)
- Adjusted the spawn from the key to the power house
- Passing out no longer leads to not being able to call Sam
- Fixed the double trigger from finding the power box
- Subtitles improved
- When you faint, you can no longer hold your mobile phone in your hand
- Misleading voice lines adjusted according to certain situations
- Fixed the brightness slider in the game (Only worked in the menu)
- The time from the mobile phone has been adjusted so that the hours are no longer repeated
- The interruption of voice lines in certain situations has been prevented
- Achievements are now unlocked in real time
- The Achievement "Tall Man In A Suit" has been fixed

We would like to thank you once again and hope that you will continue to give us lots of feedback! Feel free to write us your ideas!

notes.title: Psych Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We have received a lot of feedback from you guys, which really helps us, so thank you very much! We've made some adjustments and bug fixes that will hopefully enhance the experience for you:

New
- The arrow on the note "The Entrance" has been removed as it was causing confusion
- The vibration from the smartphone has been made a little louder so that you don't miss any more messages
- A little help for the puzzle at the phone booth has been placed

Bugs
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at the start of the game.
- Fixed a bug where you could not interact with the note or the safe

We hope you like the demo! We have placed a total of 3 easter eggs, have you found them yet?

Little hint: Try to call the devil
